title: Readiness
description: What is real in a build, per catalog row (ADR-0080 decision 4): the readiness document the walking skeleton shows. A pure function of the repository: the product version and the SHA-256 of the catalog identify it, no timestamp. It is a product-owned document identified by `schema` (<product>.readiness/v<N>), so it carries no `contract_version`; the product template's readiness document validates unchanged. Closed: unknown keys are refused. The rules the state implies (reason, provenance, missing) are semantic checks.

status.description: real once the real producer serves the row; active (the catalog's word) or the provider kind while a provider does.

provenance.description: What actually served the row in this build; null when nothing did (state missing).

reason.description: A reason: a non-blank string, or an object with a non-blank 'en' (bilingual products add 'es'); null only when available.

missing.description: For partial: what is absent. Empty otherwise.
